## TRA Timeline

#### Business Combination Agreement and form-of TRA filing

- 2023-05-09: Alchemy SPAC IPO closes (ALCY; originally VAM Acquisition Corp.)
- 2025-08-22: Business Combination Agreement with Cartiga, LLC signed; form-of TRA attached as Exhibit 10.5 to BCA-announcing 8-K
- 2026-Q1: Closing expected; executed TRA pending S-4 effectiveness and Cartiga shareholder approval

## Explanation

Alchemy Investments Acquisition Corp 1 is a Cayman SPAC that, on August 22, 2025, signed a Business Combination Agreement with Cartiga, LLC contemplating a Delaware Up-C structure under which the post-domestication entity (Cartiga Holdings, Inc.) will be the public company and will execute a Tax Receivable Agreement with the rolling Cartiga members at Closing. The form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.5 to the BCA-announcing 8-K commits the future PubCo to pay 85% of cash tax benefits realized from Section 754 basis step-ups on future exchanges of Cartiga LLC units (with paired Class B shares) for Class A common stock, plus imputed interest deductions. As of the latest filing in this directory (a 10-K/A filed April 2026), the business combination has not closed; the agreement is unexecuted and the parties and execution date will be set at Closing. The TRA will become operative only on execution; until then, the firm holds a form-of contract rather than a live obligation. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
